metadata.description: Email address for all SOC cost and compliance alerts

resources.comments: Alert 1: GPU spot cluster active outside 00:00-06:00 UTC training window. Indicates a runaway job. Uses AmlComputeClusterEvent (correct table) with datetime_part() (valid KQL function). NodeCount > 0 was incorrect — TargetNodeCount is the right field.
resources.name: [concat('alert-gpu-runaway-', parameters('env'))]

properties.displayName: GPU spot cluster active outside training window

allOf.query: AmlComputeClusterEvent | where ClusterName contains 'gpu-spot' | where TargetNodeCount > 0 | where datetime_part('Hour', TimeGenerated) !between (0 .. 6)

resources.comments: Alert 2: APIM AI call volume exceeds 500k/hour. Indicates prompt injection loop or misconfigured client. Metric is ai_call_count (renamed from ai_token_usage — value=1 per call, not actual token count).
resources.name: [concat('alert-apim-call-spike-', parameters('env'))]

properties.displayName: APIM AI call volume spike > 500k per hour

allOf.query: customMetrics | where name == 'ai_call_count' | summarize Total=sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 1h)

resources.comments: Alert 3: HIPAA CRITICAL — PHI sanitization bypass detected at APIM gateway. Severity 0 = immediate page. Queries ApiManagementGatewayLogs for HTTP 400 responses matching the PHI check-header policy error message.
resources.name: [concat('alert-phi-bypass-', parameters('env'))]

properties.displayName: HIPAA CRITICAL — PHI sanitization bypass detected

allOf.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ResponseCode == 400 | where Message contains 'PHI-sanitized'

resources.comments: Alert 4: Wazuh AKS cluster node count below minimum. Uses KubeNodeInventory (correct table for AKS node health) instead of AzureDiagnostics kube-audit, which does not expose node counts. Fires if ready nodes < 2 (below minimum for HA).
resources.name: [concat('alert-wazuh-offline-', parameters('env'))]

properties.displayName: Wazuh AKS node count below minimum

allOf.query: KubeNodeInventory | where ClusterName contains 'aks-wazuh' | where Status == 'Ready' | summarize NodeCount=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where NodeCount < 2
